fields.statement: ArgentSea Core is published as a single NuGet package (id ArgentSea, Title "ArgentSea core library") licensed MIT, built for .NET 10.0 only. Its NuGet package version is tracked independently of its assembly/file version, which does not move with the package version. A consumer that needs to identify a specific build at the loaded-assembly level must key off the assembly version, not the NuGet package version, since the two do not move together.
